cursor.description: field holding the current read cursor into the input string

buffer_start.description: field holding the start of the input string buffer

buffer_length.description: field holding the length of the input string buffer

unchecked_lookahead_read.description: macro/accessor that performs a lookahead read from the cursor without bounds checking

bounds_checked_lookahead_read.description: macro/accessor that performs a bounds-checked lookahead read from the cursor

duplicator.description: function that duplicates a C string into a newly allocated buffer

length_of.description: standard C library function returning the length of a null-terminated string

null_check.description: explicit null check on the duplicated buffer pointer
